public_rationale: A launch-day independent test reports compositional failures in Nano Banana, alongside successes. Google also acknowledges remaining factual-detail limitations. These records provide some support, but do not establish recurring difficulties across the latest models under the contract. The broader claim remains unresolved; this is not evidence that compositionality was solved.
limitations: The independent test is small and selected, and its outputs were not independently rescored.
Company statements about factual detail are not compositionality measurements.
Successful prompts in e1 limit any reading that Nano Banana generally cannot compose unfamiliar combinations.

our_interpretation: Compositionality means correctly combining requested objects, attributes, counts, spatial relations, and parts.
The ordinary reading is that meaningful compositional difficulties persist in frontier image generators, including Nano Banana. It does not imply universal failure or no improvement.
For this ongoing observation, use August 2025 through publication, covering contemporary public tests of the models under discussion.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous evaluations document recurring substantive compositional errors in Nano Banana and other frontier image generators on clearly specified prompts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative contemporaneous evaluations show reliable compositional performance across the relevant models, with the alleged difficulties attributable to ambiguous prompts, misidentified models, or unrepresentative examples.
